## Activity

River Outreach completed 33 captures during February 2022. Activity was recorded for the month as planned, with the available images submitted for review and grading. The capture total provides the basis for assessing image quality and grading outcomes across the service period.

## Image quality

Of the images submitted, 5 were ungradable. This corresponds to an ungradable rate of 15.2 per cent. Ungradable images could not be assessed reliably, so they were excluded from decisions based on image interpretation. The result should continue to be monitored through routine review of capture and image-quality practice.

## Grading

Grading identified 4 referable results. The median lag between capture and grading was 15 days. This measure indicates the typical interval for completed grading during February 2022 and should be considered alongside the number of referable results and the ungradable rate.

Staff raised no new equipment faults this month. Overall, the activity record provides a clear summary of captures, image quality, grading outcomes and turnaround for River Outreach.
